title: dartrics dismissals sidecar
description: Schema for the YAML sidecar that records deliberate dismissals (// dartrics:dismiss). Loaded when `dartrics.dismissals.sources.yaml: true` in analysis_options.yaml.

version.description: Schema version. Bumped on breaking changes; `1` is the only currently-supported value.

dismissals.description: Ordered list of dismissal entries. When two entries share the same (file, scope, metric) triple the later entry wins.

file.description: Project-root-relative path of the .dart file the dismissal targets. Compared exactly against MetricRecord.file.

scope.description: Scope name (e.g. `parse`, `Foo.bar`, `Foo.named`, or the file path for library-level metrics). Compared exactly against MetricRecord.scope.name.

metric.description: Metric id this dismissal applies to (e.g. `cyclomatic-complexity`, `method-length`). One entry = one metric.

reason.description: Free-form rationale. Required when `dartrics.dismissals.requireReason: true` (default). Length is gated by `minReasonLength` (default 20 chars after trim).

by.description: Optional author tag. Required when `dartrics.dismissals.requireAuthor: true`.

at.description: Optional ISO-8601 timestamp. Required when `dartrics.dismissals.requireTimestamp: true`. Accepts both YAML quoted strings and native YAML timestamps.
